'''Ramakanth Sarabu''' (June 20, 1955 – February 11, 2021) was an Indian [[Organic chemistry|organic chemist]]. He is known for his contributions in [[Diabetes|diabetes research]], specifically the work of [[Glucokinase|Glucokinase activation]] as a treatment therapy for [[type 2 diabetes]].

== Biography ==
Ramakanth Sarabu was born in [[Hyderabad|Hyderabad, Telangana]], where he received his early education. He earned a master's degree from [[Osmania University]] in [[organic chemistry]] and his doctorate from [[Indian Institute of Technology, Madras]] in molecular rearrangements from 1979 to 1984.<ref>{{Cite web|last=ORCID|title=Ramakanth Sarabu (0000-0001-6083-3045)|url=https://orcid.org/0000-0001-6083-3045|access-date=2021-04-22|website=orcid.org|language=en}}</ref> In 1984 he moved to the US to pursue post-doctoral fellowship under [[Elias James Corey]], at [[Harvard University]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Garner|first1=Philip|last2=Ramakanth|first2=Sarabu|date=1986-06-01|title=Stereodivergent synthesis of threo and erythro 6-amino-6-deoxyheptosulose derivatives via an optically active oxazolidine aldehyde|url=https://doi.org/10.1021/jo00363a044|journal=The Journal of Organic Chemistry|volume=51|issue=13|pages=2609–2612|doi=10.1021/jo00363a044|issn=0022-3263|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Group Members: Elias James Corey|url=http://www.hcs.harvard.edu/coreylab/members/members.php|access-date=2021-04-22|website=www.hcs.harvard.edu}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Photo Gallery: Elias James Corey|url=http://www.hcs.harvard.edu/coreylab/gallery/gallery.php|access-date=2021-04-22|website=www.hcs.harvard.edu}}</ref> He did a second post-doctoral fellowship in 1985 at [[Case Western Reserve University|Case Western University]] in [[Cleveland]], [[Ohio|OH]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ramakanth Sarabu, Head of Chemistry, Cellarity|url=https://www.topionetworks.com/people/ramakanth-sarabu-604cdaee843bac550b6aba37|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210422125331/https://www.topionetworks.com/people/ramakanth-sarabu-604cdaee843bac550b6aba37|url-status=usurped|archive-date=April He died on 11 February 2021 in [[Montville, New Jersey|Montville]], [[New Jersey]],<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ramakanth Sarabu Obituary - Visitation & Funeral Information|url=https://shookscedargrove.com/book-of-memories/4531114/Sarabu-Dr-Ramakanth/index.php|access-date=2021-04-22|website=shookscedargrove.com}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> while serving as the head of chemistry at ''Cellarity''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ramakanth Sarabu|url=https://cellarity.com/team/ramakanth-sarabu|access-date=2021-04-22|website=Cellarity|language=en}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Line|first=A. TARDE On|title=Cellarity se associa à Excelra para enriquecer o banco de dados GOSTAR com a plataforma de descoberta de medicamentos|url=http://www.atarde.com.br/economia/pr-newswire/noticias/2145040-cellarity-se-associa-a-excelra-para-enriquecer-o-banco-de-dados-gostar-com-a-plataforma-de-descoberta-de-medicamentos|access-date=2021-04-22|website=Portal A TARDE|language=pt-br}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> Prior to that, from 1997 to 2012, he served at [[Hoffmann-La Roche]] at different positions like research leader, senior principal scientist etc.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ramakanth Sarabu, Head of Chemistry, Cellarity|url=https://www.topionetworks.com/people/ramakanth-sarabu-604cdaee843bac550b6aba37|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210422125331/https://www.topionetworks.com/people/ramakanth-sarabu-604cdaee843bac550b6aba37|url-status=usurped|archive-date=April 22, 2021|access-date=2021-04-22|website=www.topionetworks.com}}</ref> He then went on to become the head of medicinal chemistry at [[Bristol Myers Squibb|Biocon Bristol Myers Squibb]] R&D Center from 2012 to 2019.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Bajpai|first1=Lakshmikant|last2=Asokan|first2=Kathiravan|last3=Samy|first3=Santhiagu|last4=Murugesan|first4=Shyamsundar|last5=Gurram|first5=Ramya|last6=Lokamma|first6=Leelavathi|last7=Kanthappa|first7=Venkatesh T.|last8=Zhang|first8=Yingru|date=2016-12-01|title=A Simple and Efficient Approach for Estimating Recovery of a Preparative Reversed Phase HPLC Purification|url=https://doi.org/10.1007/s10337-016-3191-0|journal=Chromatographia|language=en|volume=79|issue=23|pages=1577–1583|doi=10.1007/s10337-016-3191-0|s2cid=100011007 |issn=1612-1112|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Europe PMC|url=https://europepmc.org/search?query=AUTH:%22Ramakanth%20Sarabu%22|access-date=2021-04-22|website=europepmc.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Subbaiah|first1=Murugaiah A. M.|last2=Meanwell|first2=Nicholas A.|last3=Kadow|first3=John F.|last4=Subramani|first4=Lakshumanan|last5=Annadurai|first5=Mathiazhagan|last6=Ramar|first6=Thangeswaran|last7=Desai|first7=Salil D.|last8=Sinha|first8=Sarmistha|last9=Subramanian|first9=Murali|last10=Mandlekar|first10=Sandhya|last11=Sridhar|first11=Srikanth|date=2018-05-10|title=Coupling of an Acyl Migration Prodrug Strategy with Bio-activation To Improve Oral Delivery of the HIV-1 Protease Inhibitor Atazanavir|url=https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jmedchem.8b00277|journal=Journal of Medicinal Chemistry|volume=61|issue=9|pages=4176–4188|doi=10.1021/acs.jmedchem.8b00277|pmid=29693401 |issn=0022-2623|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Tiwari|first1=Ranjeet|last2=Ahire|first2=Deepak|last3=Kumar|first3=Hemantha|last4=Sinha|first4=Sarmistha|last5=Chauthe|first5=Siddheshwar Kisan|last6=Subramanian|first6=Murali|last7=Iyer|first7=Ramaswamy|last8=Sarabu|first8=Ramakanth|last9=Bajpai|first9=Lakshmikant|date=2017-12-01|title=Use of Hybrid Capillary Tube Apparatus on 400 MHz NMR for Quantitation of Crucial Low-Quantity Metabolites Using aSICCO Signal|url=https://dmd.aspetjournals.org/content/45/12/1215|journal=Drug Metabolism and Disposition|language=en|volume=45|issue=12|pages=1215–1224|doi=10.1124/dmd.117.077073|issn=0090-9556|pmid=28935657|doi-access=free|url-access=subscription}}</ref>
